extracted.name: Homemade Cheddar Cheese Sauce
extracted.description: This homemade cheese sauce is made on the stovetop in less than 10 minutes with Cheddar, milk, butter, and flour for a healthy Velveeta alternative.
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Whisk in flour and salt until a paste forms.
Slowly add milk; cook and stir until fully incorporated, about 2 minutes. Add cheese.
Cook and stir until cheese is melted, about 1 to 2 minutes.
